Class EMFResourceSetHelper

java.lang.Object
io.github.lorenzobettini.emfmodelgenerator.EMFResourceSetHelper
public class EMFResourceSetHelper extends Object
Helper class for creating and configuring EMF ResourceSets. This class centralizes the logic for setting up ResourceSets with proper resource factories and save options.

The returned resource set can be used with EMFInstancePopulator when applications manage model resources directly:

ResourceSet resourceSet = EMFResourceSetHelper.createResourceSet(80);
Resource resource = resourceSet.createResource(
    URI.createFileURI("output/library.xmi"));
EObject library = EcoreUtil.create(libraryClass);
resource.getContents().add(library);

new EMFInstancePopulator().populateEObjects(library);
resource.save(null);
Author:
Lorenzo Bettini
